{{Dialogue|Windu|Safely deliver the Jedi Council's message to our allies on Albecus, but return quickly. We have foreseen much trouble on the horizon.|Yoda|Yes, Obi-Wan. To Master Windu, you must listen! Coming are the dark times. United and ready, the Jedi must be, to stop them before it is too late.|Kenobi|Not to worry, Master Yoda. At the controls of this ship, speed and safety are of little concern.|attr=[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|src=<ref name="FoS" />}}
Some [[Time/Legends|time]] preceding the events leading up to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was sent out on a '''mission''' by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to safely deliver a message from the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to their allies on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Albecus]].

==The mission==
{{Quote|Whoever you are, you're about to learn that the ''Jedi starfighter'' is full of surprises!|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]|<ref name="FoS" />}}
During his flight from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to [[Albecus]] aboard his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's prototype Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor|prototype]] [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was ambushed in an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] by the [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']], [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. Kenobi's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] was damaged in the ambush, leaving him no other choice but to engage the ''Slave I''. Fett was overwhelmed by the immense firepower of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] starfighter and was forced to flee the battle, leaving Kenobi to continue on his journey and complete his mission.<ref name="FoS" />
